reason: I already built all of this in Notion, with linked databases for classes, budget and workouts, and it syncs between my phone and laptop fine. I might poke at the free tier out of curiosity, but I'm not moving my whole setup or paying for another subscription to get what I already have.
objection: Switching cost. My Notion system took months to build and I like being able to tweak every property and view myself. An assistant building apps 'in seconds' sounds like I'd lose that control, and I don't know if this thing exists in two years.
would_change_my_mind: If it imported my Notion databases cleanly and the snap-a-receipt or whiteboard-to-the-right-database part saved me real time every week, something Notion still makes me do by hand.
